$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # variants
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
--- PASS: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/script
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/echo
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/cycle
                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/cycle/echo
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/blank
                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/blank/echo
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/more
                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/more/echo
PASS
$ cat testdata/script/twice.txtar
A1 is twice B1, which echo prints in words.
-- in/do/out/values.txt --
a1 six
-- out/echo/values.txt --
a1 six
-- variant/cycle/about --
The do/ tree errs, as on a cycle.
-- variant/cycle/properties --
circular
-- variant/cycle/in/do/error --
A1 -> B1 -> A1: cycle
-- variant/cycle/out/echo/error.txt --
A1 -> B1 -> A1: cycle
-- variant/cycle/out/echo/values.txt --
a1 six
-- variant/blank/about --
The do/ tree's output is gone, so echo prints nothing.
-- variant/blank/delete --
do/out/values.txt
-- variant/more/about --
The do/ tree gains a second output.
-- variant/more/in/do/out/b.txt --
b1 three
-- variant/more/out/echo/b.txt --
b1 three
-- variant/more/out/echo/values.txt --
a1 six

$ edit testdata/script/twice.txtar  # move cycle's properties to the base
$ go test  # variants
    script/twice: A1 is twice B1, which echo prints in words.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        echo returned no error, but the case states circular, which echo rejects.
        Fix the code, or correct the case's properties or echo's Rejects.
    script/twice/variant/cycle: The do/ tree errs, as on a cycle.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        echo returned an error, but the case states no property echo rejects:
          A1 -> B1 -> A1: cycle
        Fix the code, or state the property on the case and in echo's Rejects.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script
        --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/twice
            --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/twice/echo
            --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/cycle
                --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/cycle/echo
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/blank
                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/variant/blank/echo
